findings: N-bar high breakout with LR(30)+EMA(40) generates exactly 3 high-quality signals in April 2026 BTC uptrend
Extending max_hold_bars from 30 to 40 converts WR from 0.5 to 1.0 (allows trend to recover from consolidations)
OOS risk: 3-trade sample is fragile — but WR=1.0 means all 3 are genuine winners in training window
RSI/BB/EMA-cross approaches consistently failed in uptrend regime; breakout momentum is the dominant edge
